D5/S3/QuadraticForms/StructuredRankOneFa.name: D5.S3.QuadraticForms.StructuredRankOneFamily.continuous_family
D5/S3/QuadraticForms/StructuredRankOneFa.signature: theorem continuous_family {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (e : X ≃ₜ openSimplex (n - 1)) (A : Set X) (hA : A.Finite) (d x : ↥(Aᶜ : Set X) → (Fin n → ℝ)) (hd : Continuous d) (hx : Continuous x) (hdelta : ∀ y, pivot (diagonal (d y)) (x y) ≠ 0) (hpsd : ∀ y, (downdate (diagonal (d y)) (x y)).PosSemidef) : Aᶜ.Nonempty ∧ ((∀ y, 0 < pivot (diagonal (d y)) (x y)) ∨ ((∀ y, pivot (diagonal (d y)) (x y) < 0) ∧ ∃! j : Fin n, (∀ y, d y j < 0) ∧ (∀ i, i ≠ j → ∀ y, 0 ≤ d y i)))

D5/S3/QuadraticForms/StructuredRankOneIn.name: D5.S3.QuadraticForms.StructuredRankOneInertia.inertia_downdate
D5/S3/QuadraticForms/StructuredRankOneIn.signature: theorem inertia_downdate (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : ι → ℝ) (h : pivot A x ≠ 0) : ∃ hM : (downdate A x).IsHermitian, (0 < pivot A x → posIndex hA = posIndex hM + 1 ∧ negIndex hM = negIndex hA ∧ zeroIndex hM = zeroIndex hA + 1) ∧ (pivot A x < 0 → posIndex hM = posIndex hA ∧ negIndex hA = negIndex hM + 1 ∧ zeroIndex hM = zeroIndex hA + 1)

D5/S3/QuadraticForms/StructuredRankOneIn.name: D5.S3.QuadraticForms.StructuredRankOneInertia.kernel_split
D5/S3/QuadraticForms/StructuredRankOneIn.signature: theorem kernel_split (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : ι → ℝ) (h : pivot A x ≠ 0) : LinearMap.ker (downdate A x).mulVecLin = LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin ⊔ Submodule.span ℝ {x} ∧ Disjoint (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) (Submodule.span ℝ {x})

D5/S3/QuadraticForms/StructuredRankOneIn.name: D5.S3.QuadraticForms.StructuredRankOneInertia.nullity_downdate
D5/S3/QuadraticForms/StructuredRankOneIn.signature: theorem nullity_downdate (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : ι → ℝ) (h : pivot A x ≠ 0) : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (downdate A x).mulVecLin) = Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) + 1
